zh: 我们要不要先点几个前菜一起分着吃？
en: Shall we share a couple of {starters|entrees|appetisers|appetizers} first?

zh: 我太饱了，吃不下甜点了。
en: I'm too full for {dessert|pudding}.

zh: 能再给我们几张餐巾纸吗？
en: Could we have some more {napkins|serviettes}, please?

zh: 服务员忘了给我们拿刀叉餐具。
en: The waiter forgot to bring our {cutlery}.

zh: 能给我一把勺子喝汤吗？
en: Could I have a {spoon} for my soup?

zh: 在新西兰你一般会给小费吗？
en: Do you usually leave a {tip} in New Zealand?

zh: 这家的分量特别大。
en: The {portions|servings|serves|meals} here are huge.

zh: 这是我奶奶做苹果派的食谱。
en: This is my grandmother's {recipe} for apple pie.

zh: 这个汤只需要五种食材。
en: This soup only needs five {ingredients}.

zh: 别把锅一直放在炉子上。
en: Don't leave the pan on the {stove|cooker|hob}.

zh: 这些刀很锋利，小心点。
en: These {knives} are really sharp, so be careful.

zh: 我们点了一盘饺子一起分着吃。
en: We ordered a plate of {dumplings} to share.

zh: 能给我们看一下菜单吗？
en: Could we see the {menu}, please?

zh: 我想订今晚七点四个人的位子。
en: I'd like to make a {booking|reservation} for four people at seven tonight.

zh: 跟服务员再要点水吧。
en: Ask the {waiter|waitress|server} for some more water.

zh: 这位厨师以前在巴黎一家有名的酒店工作。
en: The {chef|cook} used to work at a famous hotel in Paris.

zh: 这是一个包含三道菜的套餐。
en: It's a set menu with three {courses|dishes}.

zh: 您有什么饮食上的忌口吗？
en: Do you have any dietary {restrictions|requirements}?

zh: 我们能把剩菜打包带回家吗？
en: Can we take the {leftovers|rest} home?

zh: 服务员用托盘端着饮料。
en: The waiter carried the drinks on a {tray}.

zh: 我盘子里的东西吃不完。
en: I couldn't finish everything on my {plate}.

zh: 我要一碗面条汤。
en: I'll have a {bowl} of noodle soup.

zh: 你会用筷子吃饭吗？
en: Can you eat with {chopsticks}?

zh: 我的叉子掉地上了，能给我换一把干净的吗？
en: I dropped my {fork} on the floor. Could I have a clean one?

zh: 能给我一根吸管喝饮料吗？
en: Could I have a {straw} for my drink?

zh: 能给我们这桌来一壶水吗？
en: Could we have a {jug|pitcher|bottle} of water for the table?

zh: 我很喜欢这个汤的味道。
en: I love the {flavour|flavor|taste} of this soup.

zh: 酱汁可以另外放在旁边吗？
en: Can I have the {sauce|dressing} on the side?

zh: 印度菜会用很多不同的香料。
en: Indian food uses lots of different {spices}.

zh: 这家咖啡馆每天早上烤二十条面包。
en: The cafe bakes twenty {loaves} of bread every morning.

zh: 喝咖啡要不要配一块蛋糕？
en: Would you like a {slice|piece} of cake with your coffee?

zh: 这个意面酱是用新鲜番茄和大蒜做的。
en: The pasta sauce is made with fresh {tomatoes} and garlic.

zh: 今晚就点外卖吧。
en: Let's just get {takeaways|takeaway|takeout} tonight.

zh: 今天的特色推荐菜有什么？
en: What are today's {specials}?

zh: 牛排配两个配菜。
en: The steak comes with two {sides}.

zh: 你们有给小孩的小份餐吗？
en: Do you have smaller meals for {children|kids}?

zh: 我的咖啡喝完了，能续杯吗？
en: My coffee's finished. Could I get a {refill|top-up}?

zh: 把它放进微波炉热两分钟。
en: Heat it up in the {microwave} for two minutes.

zh: 厨师在围裙上擦了擦手。
en: The chef wiped his hands on his {apron}.

zh: 你在柜台点餐和付款。
en: You order and pay at the {counter|bar|till}.

zh: 公共假日要加收百分之十五的附加费。
en: There's a fifteen percent {surcharge} on public holidays.

zh: 我是素食者，所以不吃肉。
en: I'm a {vegetarian|vegan}, so I don't eat meat.

zh: 我今天没什么胃口。
en: I don't have much of an {appetite} today.

zh: 我们想要一张两个人的桌子。
en: We'd like a {table} for two, please.

zh: 喝一小口这个酒，告诉我你觉得怎么样。
en: Have a {sip|taste} of this wine and tell me what you think.

zh: 我能咬一口你的汉堡吗？
en: Can I have a {bite|taste|bit} of your burger?

zh: 今晚我请客，把钱包收起来吧。
en: It's my {shout|treat|round} tonight, so put your wallet away.

zh: 能给我的咖啡杯加个盖子吗？
en: Can I have a {lid} for my coffee cup?

zh: 这家咖啡馆全天供应早餐。
en: This cafe serves {breakfast|brunch} all day.

zh: 厨房九点关门，我们得快点点餐。
en: The {kitchen} closes at nine, so we should order soon.
